chunks.head: get one's hands on
chunks.note: get/have one's hands on sth 指设法得到或触及某物。本章为“had his hands on that treasure”，指梦里摸到了那笔财宝。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“拥有”，指手已挨上

chunks.ex_en: I finally got my hands on a ticket for the show.
chunks.ex_cn: 我终于弄到了一张演出票。

chunks.head: occur to somebody
chunks.gloss: (想法)突然浮现在某人脑海；想到
chunks.note: 主语通常是某个念头，occur to sb 指它突然出现在某人心里；本章“it occurred to him”即他忽然想到。

literal.note_cn: 此处非“发生”，指想法冒出来

chunks.ex_en: A good idea suddenly occurred to me.
chunks.ex_cn: 我突然想到一个好主意。

chunks.head: in favor of
chunks.note: 表示赞同某观点或方案，反义为 against。本章指“支持这一想法的有力论据”。
chunks.ex_en: Most students were in favor of the new plan.
chunks.ex_cn: 大多数学生赞成这个新计划。

chunks.head: consist of
chunks.note: 后接组成部分；只用主动式，无进行、无被动。
chunks.ex_en: The team consists of five players.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个队由五名队员组成。

chunks.head: a handful of
chunks.note: 字面“一把”，引申指数量很少。
chunks.ex_en: Only a handful of people came to the meeting.
chunks.ex_cn: 只有寥寥几个人来开会。

chunks.head: think over
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式“thinking them over”，故 card-only。宾语常置于 think 与 over 之间。

literal.note_cn: 此处表把事情从头到尾想一遍

chunks.ex_en: Take your time and think it over before deciding.
chunks.ex_cn: 别急，做决定前好好想一想。

chunks.head: after all
chunks.note: 用于说明理由或表示“想来想去还是”；本章意为“这事说到底也许并非一场梦”。

literal.note_cn: 习语固定搭配，须整体记忆

chunks.ex_en: I thought I'd lost my keys, but they were in my bag after all.
chunks.ex_cn: 我以为钥匙丢了，结果它们终究还是在包里。

chunks.head: go for somebody
chunks.note: go for sb 指突然扑向或攻击某人；本章指梦里那恶魔一次次扑向他。
chunks.ex_en: The angry dog went for the stranger.
chunks.ex_cn: 那条恶狗扑向了陌生人。

chunks.head: find out
chunks.note: 指经过打听或调查而得知某事。
chunks.ex_en: I want to find out who broke the window.
chunks.ex_cn: 我想查清是谁打破了窗户。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: 表示毫不拖延；另有“同时”义，本章为“立刻”。

chunks.head: make the most of
chunks.note: 指把有限的条件或机会用到最好；本章那男孩把这桩谜团“想象成闹鬼”来自娱。
chunks.ex_en: Let's make the most of our short holiday.
chunks.ex_cn: 咱们要充分利用这个短假。

chunks.head: get hold of
chunks.note: get hold of sth 指设法得到或抓住某物；本章指弄到所有能找到的钥匙。
chunks.ex_en: Where can I get hold of a good map?
chunks.ex_cn: 我在哪儿能弄到一张好地图？

chunks.head: keep a lookout for
chunks.note: lookout 意为“警戒、望风”；keep a lookout for sb/sth 指留神提防某人某物。
chunks.ex_en: Keep a lookout for our bus while I buy tickets.
chunks.ex_cn: 我买票时你留意咱们的公交车。

chunks.head: get one's revenge
chunks.note: revenge 意为“报复”；get/take one's revenge on sb 指向某人报仇。
chunks.ex_en: He worked hard to get his revenge on his rival.
chunks.ex_cn: 他发愤图强，要向对手报仇。

chunks.head: lead up to
chunks.note: lead up to sth 指话题或事件一步步引向某处；本章指让 Huck 主动把话头引到那件事上。
chunks.ex_en: She slowly led up to the bad news.
chunks.ex_cn: 她慢慢地把话头引到那个坏消息上。

chunks.head: sweep away
chunks.note: 本章指“消除疑虑”；字面为把东西一扫而光。

literal.note_cn: sweep 的过去分词，此处喻“清除掉”

chunks.ex_en: The new evidence swept away all our doubts.
chunks.ex_cn: 新证据消除了我们所有的疑虑。

skipped: Number Two / No. 2 / Injun Joe / Spanish devil (专名，按要求跳过)
wasted to nothingness / sleep forsook him / a time long gone by (一次性文学表达→难句层)
make out (出处“make nothing out of it”为分离式方言否定，控量舍去)
one-horse town (真习语但较俚俗，控量舍去)
be after (we're after / going right after，备选，控量舍去)
drop into town / spy around / track him out (备选短语，控量舍去)
you bet / Now you're talking (口语招呼语，一次性)
for a moment / for a minute (太基础)
a pile (指一大笔钱的俚语，一次性)
'tain't / dog'd / ain't / foller / by jingoes / Goody / Lordy (Huck 方言拼写与感叹，迁移弱)
